users: Customers (subscribers), kitchen staff, and the owner as admin. Customers use phones and laptops; staff use a laptop in the kitchen. Source: inputs/brief.md "What customers do".
goals: Replace e-mail orders: subscriptions paid weekly, skip and pause self-service, delivery visibility, a packing list. Success: 80% of orders self-service within 3 months. Source: inputs/brief.md.
integrations: PayGate, CourierX, MailPost; see inputs/paygate-api.md, courier-api.md, mailpost-api.md. All have sandboxes.
nfr: 200 concurrent users, 99.5% monthly availability, invoices kept 7 years, personal data deleted 30 days after closing. Source: inputs/brief.md "Numbers we know" and the owner by phone.
constraints: Hosted on the owner cloud account, Postgres is licensed, no mobile app. Source: inputs/brief.md "Systems".
out-of-scope: No mobile app, no recipes, no discount codes, no multi-country (inputs/brief.md "Not now").
environments: staging and production on the owner cloud account; keys PAYGATE_API_KEY, COURIERX_API_KEY, MAILPOST_API_KEY held by finance, logistics, IT; test roles customer, kitchen, admin. Source: inputs/brief.md and owner call.

late.failure: A failed charge holds the box for 48 hours; after that the week is skipped and the customer is e-mailed. Owner by e-mail, 2026-10-05.
